concepts.def: Induced EMF = -d(flux)/dt; magnitude proportional to rate of change of magnetic flux (Faraday 1831).
Direction of induced current opposes the change producing it; conserves energy (Lenz 1834).
Vp/Vs = Np/Ns for ideal transformer; AC induces flux change in iron core.
Induced loops in solid conductors dissipate energy; laminated cores reduce them.
I_rms = I_peak / sqrt 2 for sinusoidal AC; equivalent DC for same power dissipation.
Coil rotates in magnetic field producing sinusoidal EMF; brushes and slip rings carry current.
